newsitem.title: POLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - CASPIAN STARTS BPH.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CASPIAN STARTS BPH.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities analyst Damon Palmer on Thursday started coverage of Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) with a rating of buy.

-- "Although BPH is already trading at a discount to other Polish banks with similar levels of profitability, we believe there exists significant additional room for price appreciation in BPH's shares," Palmer wrote in a report.
-- He set a 12-month price target of 305.54 zlotys, "representing a nominal zloty return of 39 percent and a U.S. dollar return of 32 percent."
-- The company's shares were off five zlotys to 215 in Warsaw.
